basic_info.description: Reduced $50K This well-maintained one-bedroom condo offers a great living space with an open floor plan. The living and dining area is large, with hardwood floors and plenty of natural light from oversized double-paned windows. A cozy fireplace adds warmth and charm to the space. The kitchen comes fully equipped with a side-by-side fridge, dishwasher, garbage disposal, and electric range with oven. There is plenty of cabinet space for storage. The bedroom is tucked in the back of the unit for added privacy, and features a walk-in closet along with two additional closets for extra storage.The building includes an deeded parking, an elevator, on-site laundry(free) in the basement, and one dedicated parking space. It's just a short walk to Valencia Street, great walk score with easy access to cafes, restaurants, shops, and public transportation.  also close to major freeways (80 & 101), making it easy to commute to the Financial District or SOMA.  This condo is ideal for those seeking a convenient and comfortable home in a sought-after neighborhood.
